description: This PHP file defines the ProjectViewDetail class which overrides the display method to customize the view behavior for 'Project' detail pages within SuiteCRM, a CRM system. It manages data retrieval and template variable assignments for rendering the project detail view.

classes.name: ProjectViewDetail
classes.description: A class that customizes the display of project detail views in SuiteCRM by overriding the display method for additional data assignment and access control.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to load the Project bean, assign template variables based on user permissions, and then call the parent display method.
